thread:
maria: Heads up — promo for release/2023 is blocked, deploy-bot flagged a cache metadata mismatch in the artifact-index job. Promotion paused.
ci-bot: Job 4521 failed: checksum mismatch reading cache-metadata.json. https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/4521
jon: looking into logs now
jon: error: remote-store returned 409 on /artifacts/2023/manifest (duplicate upload). stack: `storage/manifest.go:183`
ravi: could that be thundering-herd from CI runners? we've seen parallel uploads on re-run before
maria: likely. Options: (A) rollback artifact to last-good, (B) pin canary to known-good artifact and block stable promote, (C) force-promote (bad idea). Thoughts?
alyssa: prefer B. keep stable blocked, run canary pinned, validate smoke and metrics during change window.
jon: we have last-good tag `r2023-2026-03-18` available.
jon: pin command:
```
# pin canary to last-known-good
deploybot pin --release 2023 --artifact r2023-2026-03-18 --env canary
```
maria: @deploy-bot please apply pin and set manual hold on promotion until we clear the cache bug.
deploy-bot: Manual hold applied. Canary pinned to r2023-2026-03-18. Promotion to stable is blocked until hold removed.
ravi: starting smoke suite against pinned canary (smoke-suite:quick). will post results.
ci-bot: smoke-suite:quick: 3/3 checks passed. Duration: 4m12s. https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/4523
alyssa: good. Monitor latency, error-rate, and token-cost for next +2h change window. If anything regresses we rollback to previous commit and open incident.
maria: decision: keep canary pinned for 2 hours, no force-promote. jon, can you draft rollback playbook and update release_notes.md with a note about the pin and impact?
jon: on it. I'll add steps: how to unpin, how to promote manually, and commands for rollback. Also linking to a short runbook for cache races.
maria: filing TRACK-4521 for the cache metadata race and scheduling a patch to dedupe manifest uploads.
maria: tagging release team and ops in release channel after playbook is posted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
